THE MODEL PUBLIC RECORDS BILL, 2026
A BILL to provide for the keeping of public records in Bharat Niti Lipi and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
BE it enacted by Parliament in the Seventy-seventh Year of the Republic of India as follows:—
CHAPTER I
PRELIMINARY
1. Short title and commencement.—(1) This Act may be called the Model Public Records Act, 2026.
(2) It shall come into force on such date as the Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, appoint.
CHAPTER IV
RECORDS
8. Keeping of records.—Every public authority shall keep its records in Bharat Niti Lipi.
CHAPTER V
VERIFICATION
21. Verification.—(1) Before a record is published, the Records Officer shall verify that—
(a) it is complete;
(b) it is signed; and
(c) it is in Bharat Niti Lipi.
(2) A record that fails verification shall not be published.
22. Corrections.—Every error found in a published record shall be corrected after verification under section 21.
23. Register.—The Records Officer shall keep a register of every record verified under sub-section (1) of Section 21.
35. Amendment of certain enactments.—The enactments specified in the Schedule shall be amended in the manner specified therein.
THE SCHEDULE
(See section 35)
1. The references to records in the Model Records Act, 1990 (5 of 1990) shall be construed as references to records kept under this Act.
